note: What a Microsoft 365 customer already has, and which outside tool each part replaces. This is what lets Plainflow say 'you already pay for a route with less to sign'. Licence contents and prices are as understood in November 2026 and marked [verify]; they move. Plainflow never overrules the person's choice: it shows the lighter route beside theirs and lets them compare.

copilot_chat.label: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat
copilot_chat.does: Chat, drafting and summarising from a prompt, signed in with a work account, under Microsoft's enterprise data protection: prompts aren't used to train and stay in the Microsoft contract you already have.
copilot_chat.caveat: It only sees what you paste or upload; it doesn't read your emails or files unless you have the full Copilot licence. Make sure people use the work sign-in, not a personal one.
copilot_chat.included_note: included with every work or school Microsoft 365 licence [verify]

copilot.label: Microsoft 365 Copilot in Word, Outlook, Teams and Excel
copilot.does: The same drafting and summarising inside the apps, drawing on your own emails, files and meetings, inside the tenant.
copilot.caveat: The Anthropic models offered inside Copilot sit outside the EU Data Boundary; an admin can switch them off. Copilot sees whatever the person can already open, so file permissions need to be right first.
copilot.addon_cost: about £24 a seat a month, annual [verify]

teams_transcription.label: Teams meeting transcription and recording
teams_transcription.does: A transcript and recording of a Teams meeting, kept in the tenant, with Copilot recap if the full licence is there.
teams_transcription.caveat: People must be told the meeting is recorded. Transcripts are personal data: set who can see them and how long they're kept.
teams_transcription.included_note: included with Business Basic, A1 and above [verify]

power_automate_standard.label: Power Automate with standard connectors
power_automate_standard.does: Automations across Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, Forms and Excel, inside the tenant.
power_automate_standard.caveat: Connectors to outside systems (Xero, SQL, HTTP) are premium: about £12 a seat a month [verify].

power_apps_standard.label: Power Apps over a SharePoint list
power_apps_standard.does: A simple app for forms, trackers and lookups, with the data in a SharePoint list inside the tenant and Microsoft sign-in built in.
power_apps_standard.caveat: Dataverse and premium connectors need Power Apps Premium: about £16 a seat a month, or about £4 per app [verify]. SharePoint lists can't do row-level security.

sharepoint_sharing.label: SharePoint and OneDrive sharing
sharepoint_sharing.does: Sharing a file or folder with a named outside person as a guest, with access that can be taken back, instead of emailing a copy.
sharepoint_sharing.caveat: Guest access has to be allowed by the admin, and you still need a sharing agreement if the other organisation decides things with you.

forms.label: Microsoft Forms
forms.does: Surveys and sign-up forms with answers kept in the tenant.

desktop_apps.label: Word, Excel, PowerPoint on the desktop
desktop_apps.does: Templates and design in PowerPoint and Word.
desktop_apps.included_note: included with Business Standard, E3, A3 and above [verify]

purview_basic.label: Purview information protection (basic)
purview_basic.included_note: included with Business Premium, E3, A3 and above [verify]

purview_dlp.label: Purview data loss prevention
purview_dlp.does: Rules that stop sensitive data being shared or pasted into the wrong place, including into Copilot.

azure_openai.label: Azure OpenAI in your own tenant
azure_openai.does: The same models as ChatGPT, run in your own Azure subscription and region, under the Microsoft contract, for an app you build.
azure_openai.caveat: Needs an Azure subscription and someone to set it up; pay per use.
azure_openai.addon_cost: pay per use, through an Azure subscription [verify]

equivalents.note: Outside tool (product id) to the Microsoft features that do the same job, best first. 'by_purpose' and 'by_data' cover tools Plainflow doesn't know ('Something else').
